brief: Three-storey Second Renaissance Revival city hall on a street corner: rusticated stone ground floor, smooth ashlar above, a giant-order columned portico on the corner entrance, heavy cornice and balustraded parapet. Inside, a columned vestibule with a chandelier; flagpole and a war memorial on the lawn out front.
